content.title: Fix phase1 header assertion — scope regex to header landmark
content.description:
The phase1 'renders the agentrack header' test STILL FAILS after the first fix (mqe06bbvql). Validation report (comment mqgujs3l7n on mqe06b32sm):

Root cause: phase1-validation.spec.ts:42 uses `page.getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i })` which resolves to 3 elements (strict-mode violation) because issue-list links whose titles contain 'agentrack' also match (e.g. 'Webapp: Build the agentrack...').

Playwright error: strict mode violation: getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i }) resolved to 3 elements

Suggested fix (pick one — A preferred):
- Option A: scope to the header landmark — `page.locator('header').getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i })`
- Option B: exact string match — `page.getByRole('link', { name: 'agentrack', exact: true })`

Update ONLY the test assertion. Do NOT change the implementation (Header.tsx). This is a test-only fix.

content.content:
Done. Fixed the phase1 'renders the agentrack header' test by scoping the link locator to the header landmark.

What changed (test-only):
- e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts:42 — changed `page.getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i })` to `page.locator('header').getByRole('link', { name: /agentrack/i })` (Option A from the issue).

Why: issue-list links whose titles contain 'agentrack' (e.g. 'Webapp: Build the agentrack...') also matched the unscoped locator, causing a Playwright strict-mode violation (resolved to 3 elements). Scoping to the header landmark uniquely targets the brand link. No implementation (Header.tsx) changes.

Verified: ran `bunx playwright test e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts` — all 7 phase1 tests pass, including the previously-failing 'renders the agentrack header' test.
